label: Image 09
anatomyReview: Exactly six arms: raised upper pair, outward support-resting middle pair, lap/knee-resting lower pair; six separated hands. Two legs and two feet on ledge. Two antennae.
designReview: Large head and compound eyes, compact seated body, elevated civic chair/plinth. Full support and antennae within frame. Head height relative to companions remains to be calibrated during assembly.
